entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes I bought. Order number is VF88602.
Okay, I'm pulling up that order now... I see the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?
They gave me terrible blisters on my first ride. They just don't fit.
I'm very sorry to hear that. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Was there any issue with installing the cleats, or was it purely a sizing problem?

I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see they were delivered 26 days ago, and our policy for standard items allows for returns within 10 days. So yes, we can absolutely get a full refund started for you.

Of course. I am emailing a prepaid return label to the address on file right now. Just be sure to remove any personal cleats you might have attached before you box them up. Once our warehouse receives the cycling shoes, we'll process that refund back to your original payment method.

I also see here that you're one of our VIP members, and we sincerely appreciate your business. For the trouble with the blisters and the poor fit, I've gone ahead and added a $25 store credit to your account for a future purchase. Hopefully we can find you a pair that works much better.
You're welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
